shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat stone surface
animals/creatures or figures shown in profile
schematic body outlines with incised interior detail
justification: Both are relief-carved surfaces showing profile subjects with rows of repeated small elements (a band of chevrons/animals in A; rows of beaded curls and embroidery dots in B), but the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows schematic zoomorphic creatures, birds and quadrupeds stacked in registers on a pillar, while B shows a single large naturalistic human bust in profile with elaborate coiffure, beard, earring and headdress. There is no shared specific motif or relationship, and the styles are opposed — flat, abstracted animal outlines versus modelled anatomical portraiture.
